mairie.name: La mairie · Town Hall
mairie.alt: The village town hall painted in ink and gouache: a yellow dress with an address tag on a coat stand, a framed photo of a smiling toe, a green trash can with a bell, three eels waiting in line with a ticket, an ID card driving a red go-kart, Monsieur Verbe waiting beside a sun-tanned dragon in sunglasses, signing at a lectern with a quill and writing on a long scroll, the mayor mare in a tricolor sash with golden scissors, a flag draped over a stool, a donkey in glasses at his desk, a girl in a yellow raincoat showing a passport at a rainy window, a boy with a bouquet and a pocket watch and a gnome with a name badge; the open front door on the left leads to the village a blue door on the right leads to the post office and a teal double door in the back wall opens onto the council chamber; beside the clock a half-open burgundy door shows the chandelier of the reception hall; behind the horse a half-open teal door shows the archive drawers.

doors.hint: Through the blue door to the post office

doors.hint: Through the teal double door to the council chamber

doors.hint: Through the half-open burgundy door beside the clock to the reception hall

bureau.name: Le bureau · Office
bureau.alt: Close-up of the donkey's desk, cut from the town hall painting: the mayor mare's sash and golden scissors at the left, the gray donkey in glasses writing with a quill, an inkwell, a letter sealed with a red heart, a key made of orange clay standing in its lump, a lop-eared bunny licking an envelope shut, a stamp showing a tambourine, a stylish pen with a pink scarf and the gnome's red hat peeking in.

poste.name: La poste · Post Office
poste.alt: The village post office painted in ink and gouache: a teal door back to the town hall, a calendar with a dart in one square, a smiling cassette wearing a mail carrier's cap, an easel with a poster of an orange fish, a suitcase on a red leash, the post-office counter, Monsieur Verbe throwing a paper-plane letter, calling on an apple held to his ear and wrapping a package in a pink tutu, a red telephone bouncing on a table, a ticket machine with three children waiting in a row, a collie carrying a package, a cardboard box on wheels carrying a heavy weight and a bundle of letters sprinting in running shoes.

doors.label: La mairie
doors.hint: Back through the teal door to the town hall

zooms.label: le guichet
zooms.hint: Look at what is on the post-office counter

guichet.name: Le guichet · Counter
guichet.alt: Close-up of the post-office counter in front of its brass grille: a sheet of writing paper shaped like a leaf, a cello with string wound round its neck, a blue kettle wearing a brown label, a banana tied with a red ribbon, an open red present full of soft modeling dough and a little packet giving an OK sign.

conseil.name: La salle du conseil · Council Chamber
conseil.alt: The town council chamber painted in ink and gouache: a woman pulls the cord of a ceiling fan, a goat walks along the bench tops, a grandpa holds up a hand to stop a duckling, a smiling councillor holds up one single salmon, a donkey brays at a surprised man, a councillor bangs a gavel, a bearded man waits his turn holding one big pink candy, a pitcher overflows a glass while a bald man raises his hand, Ann shows a young man how to fold a ballot into the box, a gray-haired lady works a shrugging hand puppet; the teal double door on the left leads back to the town hall and the arched alcove on the right opens onto the councillors' gallery; a narrow arched doorway in the back wall gives a glimpse of the civic hall's open day; a narrow wooden side door in the right wall stands half open onto the sunny courtyard fair.

doors.hint: Back through the teal double door to the town hall

zooms.hint: Peek through the narrow arched doorway into the civic hall

zooms.label: la cour
zooms.hint: Step through the narrow side door into the courtyard fair

tribune.name: La tribune · Councillors' Gallery
tribune.alt: Close-up of the councillors' gallery in the chamber alcove: a lady with an umbrella at a rainy window, a knight holding up ten fingers, a video man filming a cat beside a pie, a snail crossing a finish ribbon, a sleeping councillor whose wig slides down, a ginger councillor banging his fist so the inkpots jump, a boy called Dan with a saucepan and a cookie, a striped strongman diving to catch a falling pitcher, a gray-haired lady holding up a blank certificate and a vase of roses with one dahlia.

archives.name: Les archives · Town Archives
archives.alt: The town archives painted in ink and gouache: a young man waves a small black-red-gold flag, a cool archivist in sunglasses shows two children a lute and a lace fan, a baker leans in through the window with a basket of baguettes, a man pins picture postcards on a globe, an archivist opens Russian nesting dolls as the smallest vanishes in a puff, a girl files windmill postcards into a drawer, a woman opens a big book tied with a blue-white-red ribbon, a waffle carries a tiny black-yellow-red flag, a young man in a navy coat holds an Eiffel Tower postcard, a gondolier in a straw boater sings with a rolled map, a spaniel dances with hand bells and a traveler carries a sticker-covered suitcase; the teal door on the left leads back to the town hall and the teal arched door on the right leads to the visa office.

doors.label: La mairie
doors.hint: Back through the teal door to the town hall

doors.label: Le service des visas
doors.hint: The teal arched door on the right, to the visa office

zooms.label: la salle des cartes
zooms.hint: Look through the arched doorway into the map room

cartes.name: La salle des cartes · Map Room
cartes.alt: The archives map room painted in ink and gouache: a general covered in medals sorts color-coded folders, a boy turns the dial on a giant globe, a girl waves a paper fan under a red Chinese lantern beside a little dragon, an official in a sash bangs a giant rubber stamp, a woman folds a flag into a box, a green parrot squawks from a teak podium, a man holds a map of a winding river beside a carved giraffe, a young woman files a prairie map and a bison postcard, a party guest lines up shoe boxes by size, a drawer spills a compass, a feather, a key and flippers, a fox family snuggles in a den under the table while children peek in, a corgi in a tiny crown sits on a velvet cushion and a friendly uncle chats with a line.

civique.name: La salle des associations · Civic Hall
civique.alt: Close-up of the civic hall's open day, seen through the narrow arched doorway of the council chamber: a lady dressed as the Statue of Liberty holding up a torch, club ladies in flowered hats, balloons popping over a crowd being counted, a lady handing out matching socks, a lady holding a giant onion tied with a ribbon, a girl dancing alone with a ribbon, neighbors watering a shared vegetable planter, two girls level on a seesaw, a man in a flat cap waving a red flag toward a painted sunrise, a man raising his right hand with a giant pencil at an easel, a man showing a blank membership card with a rosette, a man holding an umbrella over a leaky kitten shelter, three men in matching plaid kilts, and, roped off on a dark marble pedestal, a plain framed blank museum plaque.

cour.name: La cour des associations · Community Courtyard
cour.alt: The town hall's sunny inner courtyard on community-fair day, seen through the council chamber's side door: three cheerful marchers with blank placards and a drum, a big three-generation family popping out from behind a potted olive tree shouting boo, a man holding a model village round a green common with one toy cow, a girl holding a toy merry-go-round with four horses, four friends linking arms on one solid granite block, a boy sharing a whole fruit pie with another boy, a level brass scale with two equal eggs beside a tipped scale with one huge and one tiny egg, a boy in a party hat raising his hand to join in, and a plain framed blank plaque on a low stand; on the right a clerk stamps forms at the registration table under the arcade.

honneur.name: Le salon d'honneur · The reception hall
honneur.alt: The town hall's grand reception hall under a crystal chandelier with a sparrow on it: a bride and groom cut their wedding cake among rose petals, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret with an accordion on his chest holds out a gold key with a red bow, a gray-haired minister sips pink punch through a mini straw by the buffet, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret holds a clarinet high and makes an announcement, a blushing president lifts a gold trophy cup, a deputy in a tricolor sash putts a golf ball on a little green mat, a waiter brings a tray of gray ice-cream cones to the delegates, and a boy walks his fingers up the mini staircase of a model ministry. The burgundy double door on the left leads back to the lobby, the pale-green door at the back left to the paperwork office and the navy-blue door at the back right to the polling hall.

doors.label: La mairie
doors.hint: The burgundy double door on the left, back to the town hall lobby

doors.label: Les papiers
doors.hint: The pale-green door at the back left, to the paperwork office

doors.label: Les élections
doors.hint: The navy-blue door at the back right, to the polling hall

papiers.name: Le bureau des papiers · The paperwork office
papiers.alt: The town hall's paperwork office with tall windows on the village square: a tour guide with a yellow pennant signs at a lectern while two tourists in sun hats wave goodbye, a man with an armful of papers marches with high knees, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret draws a big green check on a postcard of a sunny valley, a young doe nibbles the file a clerk holds over the counter, a doctor points a billiard cue at the cork notice board, a gray-haired lady sews a ribbon onto a document while a clerk presses a brass seal into red wax, and a freckled boy with a curly perm in pink rollers holds up his pink permit. The pale-green door on the right leads back to the reception hall, and the forest-green door at the far right leads to the youth parliament.

doors.label: Le salon d'honneur
doors.hint: The pale-green door on the right, back to the reception hall

doors.label: Le parlement des jeunes
doors.hint: The forest-green door at the far right, to the youth parliament

vote.name: La salle des élections · The polling hall
vote.alt: The town hall's polling hall on election day, with three voting booths with blue curtains: a cook pushes a cart of copper pans under a blank placard, two band musicians play under a long blank banner, Monsieur Verbe in a gold beret sits on top of the booths leering at his ballot, a campaign poster shows a grinning candidate pulling a candy cane from a top hat, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret drops his envelope into the clear ballot box holding a teacup, an elderly voter lectures a bored teenager, a supporter with a rosette waves a giant wedge of parmesan, and two friends lift the newly elected man onto their shoulders. A dog with a tricolor bow waits politely. The navy-blue door on the left leads back to the reception hall and the yellow double door at the back right to the village hall.

doors.label: Le salon d'honneur
doors.hint: The navy-blue door on the left, back to the reception hall

doors.label: La salle des fêtes
doors.hint: The yellow double door on the right, to the village hall

fetes.name: La salle des fêtes · The village hall
fetes.alt: The town hall's village hall decorated with bunting for the fair: a man pays at the ticket table while the cashier yawns over her cash tin, a beekeeper lady rents a table stacked with honey jars, a proud fireman with a medal stands before the stage, an old man in a blue paisley shirt dozes in a folding chair on the stage, a volunteer in a green apron keeps a beach ball going with two children, and a strongman carries a whole upright piano across the hall. The yellow double door on the left leads back to the polling hall and the lilac door in the right wall, beside the big window, to the rehearsal room.

doors.label: Les élections
doors.hint: The yellow double door on the left, back to the polling hall

doors.label: La salle polyvalente
doors.hint: The lilac door in the back right wall, to the rehearsal room

polyvalente.name: La salle polyvalente · The rehearsal room
polyvalente.alt: The town hall's rehearsal room with a low stage and a gray curtain: a mailman with a green parrot on his shoulder brings a parcel, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret beckons his shy sister with a ukulele out from behind the curtain, a stagehand in overalls lines up a gold crown, a brass lantern and a toy rocking horse on a shelf, a little boy offers his sister a big lemon and she crosses her arms, a round man in a red sweater carries a long table on his head, and a lanky helper is hung all over with tote bags, one handle in his teeth. The lilac door on the left leads back to the village hall, the sky-blue door beside it to the twin-towns hall and the olive-green door on the right to the registry office.

doors.label: La salle des fêtes
doors.hint: The lilac door on the left, back to the village hall

doors.hint: The olive-green door on the right, to the registry office

jumelage.name: La salle du jumelage · The twin-towns hall
jumelage.alt: The town hall's twin-towns hall under strings of colorful flags, with a big painted map of Europe: a baker in a black hat and lace collar holds up a huge caramel flan, a cow in a flower garland poses on a red rug for a photographer, a polite astronaut bows, a ginger cat naps on a green cushion on a little table, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret shakes maracas and leads a samba line of guests, and a lion mascot in a yellow jersey dances. In the near left corner a big bass fish sits in a washtub holding up its passport while a clerk stamps it. A hedgehog sniffs a grape by the coat stand. A plum door at the back leads to the delegations' lunch. The sky-blue double door on the right leads back to the rehearsal room.

doors.label: La salle polyvalente
doors.hint: The sky-blue door on the right, back to the rehearsal room

doors.label: Le buffet des délégations
doors.hint: The plum door at the back, to the delegations' lunch

etatcivil.name: Le bureau de l'état civil · The registry office
etatcivil.alt: The town hall's registry office with a long wooden counter and a checkered floor: a surprised man holds up a white form card with a silver fish flopping on it, a round boy shows his ant farm to an old clerk, a jester yawns at the manager's desk piled with papers, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret gives a thumbs-up to a red toy car on a little lift, a clerk polishes a brass bell, a boy plays ping-pong with a rubber stamp, and by the window a white marble statue points at a little tally scoreboard on the wall. The olive-green door on the left leads back to the rehearsal room and the dark-red door to the finance office.

doors.label: La salle polyvalente
doors.hint: The olive-green door on the left, back to the rehearsal room

doors.label: Les finances
doors.hint: The dark-red door at the back left, to the finance office

finances.name: Le bureau des finances · The finance office
finances.alt: The town hall's finance office with an old safe and a window onto the village church: two farmers present a giant golden pear on a red cushion, a scruffy terrier runs off with a banknote while the treasurer lunges after it, an owl on the safe has a cupcake with one candle, Monsieur Verbe in a red beret holds out his hand to a seagull holding his clam on the windowsill, a boy cheers at a model mining town on a table, a brass balance scale on the desk holds one kitten in each level pan, and a grandmother pours coins from a jug into a glass jar. The dark-red door on the right leads back to the registry office.

doors.label: L'état civil
doors.hint: The dark-red door on the right, back to the registry office

guichets.name: Le service population · The registration office
guichets.alt: Le service population: the registration and records office of a French village town hall: a long honey-oak service counter with three open service windows across the back, tall gray steel filing cabinets along the right wall, a waiting bench, an old-fashioned photo booth with a red curtain in the left back corner, cream plaster walls. travel-agency lady flying a toy plane over a map; clerk puzzled by identical twins; clerk steadying a teetering tower of forms; mime giving a firm handshake; mime summoning a convoy of toy trucks; snail crawling along a spiral district map; boy placing the last piece in a jigsaw map of France; fisherman hooking a file out of a drawer; mom with a baby holding a birth certificate; town crier reading a scroll. The mustard-yellow door on the left, back to the town exhibition.

doors.label: L'exposition
doors.hint: The mustard-yellow door on the left, back to the town exhibition

parlement.name: Le parlement des jeunes · The youth parliament
parlement.alt: Le parlement des jeunes: the youth parliament chamber of a French village town hall: curved tiers of honey-oak benches in a half-circle around a raised president's desk, a tall carved president's chair, a big painting of a domed parliament building on the back wall, cream plaster walls, deep blue carpet. teacher pointing at a Greek temple poster; teller sorting ballots into two piles; three teens folding their arms and shaking heads; two pupils carrying a huge book on a cushion; girl climbing into the tall president's chair; girl pointing at a painting of a domed parliament; teens holding up green voting cards; party members with orange rosettes and balloons; classmates pushing forward their representative; children dropping beads into two jars; courier setting down a red dispatch box; mime applauding and nodding approval. The forest-green door on the left, back to the papers office. The walnut door at the back left, to the debate room. The cherry-red door on the right, to the clubs' hall.

doors.hint: The cherry-red door on the right, to the clubs' hall

debats.name: La salle des débats · The debate room
debats.alt: La salle des débats: the long, wide citizens' debate room of a French village town hall: one big round worn red rug in the middle of the room with a ring of mismatched wooden chairs and one standing microphone, where everyone gathers; at the far left, tall honey-oak bookcases with a rolling library ladder; at the far right, a tall window and a big brass floor lamp; wide empty floorboards between the rug and the side walls, cream plaster walls. woman holding a clear glass up to the light; man at the microphone waving a hot dog; boy pinching himself in disbelief; lady raising an eyebrow at a man and his dog in headphones; woman holding up a tiny bottle of rose essence; boy returning a found wallet; man wearing enormous fake ears; official blowing a whistle, arm raised; girl cradling a white dove; mime pleading with a grumpy old man; mime wagging his finger at a nodding deer. The walnut door on the left, back to the youth parliament. The slate-gray door at the back right, to the planning committee.

doors.label: Le parlement des jeunes
doors.hint: The walnut door on the left, back to the youth parliament

doors.label: La commission d'urbanisme
doors.hint: The slate-gray door at the back right, to the planning committee

commission.name: La commission d'urbanisme · The planning committee
commission.alt: La commission d'urbanisme: the planning committee room of a French village town hall: a long table covered with a green cloth where three committee members sit at the back, one long cluster of low trestle tables with residents' cardboard and balsa-wood building models in the middle of the room, where everyone gathers; tall windows on the left wall with empty floor in front of them; rolled plans in a basket, pale sage-green walls, a herringbone oak floor. grandpa refusing a foosball table; mime retorting with a raised finger; two brothers pulling a model house opposite ways; man squinting at a blurry drawing; woman checking a model roof with a spirit level; girl peering into a model house window; woman pushing a toy ice-cream van, singing; man hammering a model down for good; pony moaning but carrying rolled plans; builder putting on a hard hat; inspector measuring a model fence. The slate-gray door on the right, back to the debate room.

doors.label: La salle des débats
doors.hint: The slate-gray door on the right, back to the debate room

associations.name: La maison des associations · The clubs' hall
associations.alt: La maison des associations: the clubs' hall of a French village town hall on club fair day: club tables with plain colored tablecloths along the walls, a big coffee urn, a climbing-club practice wall with colored holds in the back corner, butter-yellow walls, a pale oak floor. tall teen ducking under a height bar; three dancing couples, each a woman and a man; chatty lady pouring coffee for a laughing crowd; girl riding off as dad holds the training wheels; brother carrying his little brother piggyback; new citizen taking an oath, family clapping; hooded man tiptoeing from a donation box; grandpa nodding yes to his grandson; grocer lifting a barrier at his fruit stall; teen volunteer sweeping the floor; teacher leading a line of small pupils; mime with a sticker stuck to his glove. The cherry-red door on the left, back to the youth parliament. The turquoise door at the back right, to the exhibition.

doors.hint: The cherry-red door on the left, back to the youth parliament

doors.label: L'exposition
doors.hint: The turquoise door at the back right, to the exhibition

expo.name: L'exposition · The town exhibition
expo.alt: L'exposition: the exhibition room of a French village town hall set up for a 'People and history' exhibition: one long glass display case running across the middle of the room with easels and a potted tropical palm beside it, where everyone gathers; empty display cases and empty easels along the far left and far right walls; pale gray walls, a polished stone floor. believer coloring with a giant crayon; grandma and granddaughter flexing arms; boy pointing at a flock of swallows; man fanning himself under a banana palm; scientist studying an old clay pot; aristocrat with a lorgnette; medieval man laying a foundation stone; student reading under a bearded marble bust; child peeking out of a yurt; guide pointing at a painting of a residential street. The turquoise door on the left, back to the clubs' hall. The mustard-yellow door on the right, to the registration office.

doors.hint: The mustard-yellow door on the right, to the registration office

nations.name: Le buffet des délégations · The delegations' lunch
nations.alt: Le buffet des délégations: the long dining room of a French village town hall set for a lunch with visiting delegations from many countries: one big round table with a white tablecloth and dishes from everywhere in the middle of the room, where everyone gathers; a carved wooden sideboard against the far left wall; tall windows on the far right wall; wide empty parquet between the table and the side walls, plum-red walls. chef carrying an island-shaped chestnut cake; guest assembling a flat-pack chair; kangaroo handing a man cabbage rolls; waiter with a croissant breakfast tray; businesswoman wearing many wristwatches; boy watching a toy subway train; girl laying out the parts of a sandwich; goose hissing at a guest; guests dipping bread in fondue; woman pouring maple syrup on pancakes. The plum door on the left, back to the twin-towns hall.

doors.label: Le jumelage
doors.hint: The plum door on the left, back to the twin-towns hall

visas.name: Le service des visas · The visa and passport office
visas.alt: Le service des visas: the visa and passport office of a French village town hall: pale sky-blue plaster walls with white moldings, a black-and-white checkered floor, a long walnut counter with three glass service windows across the back wall, a red-and-white striped barrier arm across a gap at the right end of the counter. clerk checking an ID card photo; traveler kneeling and waving a white handkerchief; woman on a Union Jack suitcase; man with a gold title belt holding up his passport; two diplomats shaking hands; stonemason chiseling a blank stone tablet; backpacker with a boomerang; guard pointing at yellow footprints on the floor; envoy bowing with a sealed letter; consul at his window with a small foreign flag; woman holding up a visa page; old man filling in an endlessly long form; guard lifting a barrier for a man with a pass. The teal arched door on the left, back to the archives. The walnut door on the right, to the mayor's office.

doors.hint: The teal arched door on the left, back to the archives

doors.hint: The walnut door on the right, to the mayor's office

cabinet.name: Le cabinet du maire · The mayor's office
cabinet.alt: Le cabinet du maire: the mayor's office in a French village town hall: warm dark walnut wall paneling, a dark green carpet, a big carved walnut desk with a green leather top in the middle back, a tall window with heavy green velvet curtains in the back wall, a French tricolor flag on a pole in the back corner, low bookshelves. aide polishing a bust of Marianne; councilwoman tracing the village boundary on a framed map; secretary sealing a folder with a finger on her lips; aide explaining a clear picture diagram on an easel; boss in an executive chair signing at the desk; aide creeping quietly with a coffee tray; intern pushing an internal mail cart; minister hugging a red portfolio; farmer firmly refusing a giant pen; bank governor holding up a sheet of banknotes; framed painting of ministers around a table; old man whispering a secret to his friend. The walnut door on the left, back to the visa office. The navy-blue door on the right, to the press room.

presse.alt: La salle de presse: the press room of a French village town hall: pale gray walls, a deep blue curtain hanging behind a small wooden podium on a low stage at the left, rows of folding chairs with reporters, camera tripods, a light honey-oak floor. spokeswoman reading a statement at the podium; forest of microphones and a TV camera; technician untangling a knot of cables; man hiding behind a newspaper; man shushing through a giant megaphone; reporter unveiling a never-seen photo; reporter with a magnifying glass at a muddy puppy; ad man unrolling an advertising poster; drenched weatherman holding a sunny forecast; reporter in fake nose glasses; woman giving two thumbs up; photographer comparing a tall and a wide frame. The navy-blue door on the left, back to the mayor's office. The olive-green door on the right, to the counting room.

electoral.alt: La salle du dépouillement: the ballot-counting room of a French village town hall on election night: sage-green walls, a plain light wooden plank floor, two long bare trestle tables where volunteers count envelopes, a big clear plastic ballot box on the middle table. three councilors raising their hands together; clerk sorting envelopes into three baskets; woman in a leg cast holding up her signed proxy form; girl painting with three primary-color pots; volunteers tipping out the ballot box; teller holding up two fingers; two men in red and blue ties talking politics; twin boys with balloons matching their shirts; balance with two equal piles of envelopes; boy holding up his voter card; two neighbors shaking hands. The olive-green door on the left, back to the press room. The brick-red door on the right, to the civics classroom.

institutions.alt: La salle d'éducation civique: the civics classroom of a French village town hall, where visiting schoolchildren learn how the Republic works: pale yellow walls, a big dark green chalkboard on the back wall, rows of wooden school desks with chairs, a light wooden plank floor. boy in a paper general's hat barking orders; teacher stacking thick red law books; girl unrolling a sealed parchment charter; librarian holding up the big blue-white-red Constitution book; girl at a lectern reading out a new law; finished jigsaw map of colored regions on the floor; boy filling a half-circle model parliament; strict teacher raising a ruler; two children by their crashed paper plane under a chalk flight path; girl pointing at the base block of her block tower; three workers sharing out loaves of bread; boy dressed as a king on a carved chair. The dark red arched door on the left, back to the ballot-counting room. The white-and-gold door on the right, to the ceremonial hall.

inauguration.alt: La salle des cérémonies: the ceremonial hall of a French village town hall: cream walls with gilded moldings, a herringbone parquet floor, tall mirrors in gilded frames on the back wall. mayor in a sash cutting a ribbon; woman ringing a bell from a tall gilded chair; little girl climbing red steps onto a stage; man announcing a name, young woman standing up in surprise; model of a domed public building on a stand; white bust of Marianne on a pedestal; drummer boy marching with a determined face; huge five-tier cake standing on the floor; famous actress holding up her own portrait; butler in white gloves bowing stiffly with a tray; man in a smaller copy of the gilded chair; white-haired senator with a cane.
